description: Create a project (a product to track with checklists, workflows, interviews and feedback). Call list_projects first and reuse a matching project rather than creating a duplicate.

audience.description: Who the product is for, e.g. "small business owners doing their own payroll".

color.description: Six-digit hex colour for the project, e.g. #8470e5 (Violet). Prefer a palette value. Defaults to the standard project colour when omitted.

description.description: Short internal note about the project shown in the dashboard. Optional.

name.description: Display name for the project, 1 to 200 characters, e.g. "Acme checkout".

product_description.description: What the product does, in a sentence or two. Used as context for actors and interviews, so a specific description gives better runs.

url.description: Primary URL of the product, e.g. https://example.com. A missing scheme is added. When omitted, the project has no address until one is set in the dashboard.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: create_project

id.description: Project UUID, the project_id other tools take.

title: Create project
